page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a centred heading and verse lines below it. No marginal notes. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: renuntium[?], ob suspensum Raphaelem nepotem, excommunicauit, ac diris denouit: & Florentinos omnes magnis damnis oppressit. Sedis Antichristianæ fastigium ita tuebatur, ut non facile cuiquam, quamuis maximo, perfundari pateretur. Quum pacem ab Hercule Estensi, Ferrariensium duce, praeter eius voluntatem & consensum, cum Venetis fieri conspiceret, ex animi rancore, aduersante etiä podagra, quae tunc laborabat, anno Domini 1484. in quintum diem expirauit.
main_text.head: DE QVO A DIVERSIS CV-
main_text.p: Non potuit seuum vis ulla extinguere Sixtum:
Die unde Alecto pax ista refulsit, & unde
Tam subito reticent praelia? Sixtus obit.
Mortuus est Sixtus, gaudet nunc Roma: trahatur,
Vt dignum est, unco mortuus in Tiberim.
Sixtus obit, gaudent omnes: ne funere ficco
Extulit auratas sed postquam maxima glandes,
Ecclesia, innumeris patefacta est ianua portis.

page.notes: The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page; its first word is partly illegible. "renuntium[?]" is a best guess. The heading line "DE QVO A DIVERSIS CV-" is cut off at the line end and its completion is not clearly legible; the following line "dicuntur haec carmina:" is printed beneath it. The catchword "Epi" is at the bottom right. Some verse lines are faded and could not be read with certainty beyond the marked words.
